description:
Permanent documentation uses an adapted Diátaxis layout under `docs/`. A single index routes researchers to tutorials, how-to guides, concepts, reference pages and the crate entry pages.

## Background

Permanent pages target researchers evaluating or adopting gf2 and assume technical competence. Explanatory prose is freshly authored; only independently verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and empirical data are reused from prior material. Pages state current supported behavior only.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `docs/index.md` has one section each for tutorials, how-to guides, concepts and reference, plus a crate section linking the existing entry pages of `gf2-core`, `gf2-coding` and `gf2-algebra`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each section states its quadrant's purpose in one sentence and cites the registered placement invariant by address rather than restating it.
- [hard] REQ-03: The index links only to pages present in the tree, and its links resolve.
- [hard] REQ-04: The index prose carries no marketing, history or future promises.
title: Create the docs index and quadrant layout
